name: ana_tendsto_quadratic_ratio
statement: : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (((n : ℝ)) ^ 2 + 1) / (2 * ((n : ℝ)) ^ 2 + 3)) Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / 2))
closed: Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (((n : ℝ)) ^ 2 + 1) / (2 * ((n : ℝ)) ^ 2 + 3)) Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / 2))
informal: (n^2+1)/(2n^2+3) tends to 1/2 — divide numerator and denominator by n^2 and use 1/n^2 → 0, or bound |difference| = 1/(2(2n^2+3)) and squeeze.
